summary: Consensus-family JSON must expose each analyzed study's reconstructed abstract (capped, rune-safe) and a full all_studies list so content-aware downstream consumers (LLM layers) can re-filter relevance/stance from study content, not title alone.
reason: A web layer feeds this CLI's JSON to an LLM; with only top_supporting/top_refuting titles the model cannot verify stance or relevance against actual study content. The change is additive only — existing field names/types are unchanged, and scWork.Abstract keeps json:"-" so the uncapped classifier input never leaks into other outputs.
validated_outcome: consensus --json emits all_studies with non-empty abstract fields from live OpenAlex data; go build/vet/test green.
